SELECT fs.id as follow_id, fs.user_status, fs.target_id as author_id, fs.create_time as follow_time, mu.id as userId, mu.avatar_url, mu.nickname, mu.mobile, mu.create_time as register_time, mu.register_ip, mu.last_login_ip, mu.last_login_time, COALESCE(mua.total_recharge_amount, 0) as total_recharge_amount, COALESCE(mua.order_num, 0) as order_num, mua.update_time as accountUpdateTime FROM member_user_follow fs
INNER JOIN author_member_tag_relation amtr ON fs.user_id = amtr.user_id AND amtr.tag_id = #{reqVO.tagId} and amtr.deleted = 0
INNER JOIN member_user mu ON fs.user_id = mu.id LEFT JOIN member_user_account mua ON mu.id = mua.user_id
fs.status = 0 and fs.target_type = 1 and fs.target_id = #{reqVO.authorId}
AND mu.mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.mobile}, '%')
AND mu.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.nickname}, '%')
AND fs.create_time BETWEEN #{reqVO.attentionStartTime} AND #{reqVO.attentionEndTime}
AND mu.create_time BETWEEN #{reqVO.createStartTime} AND #{reqVO.createEndTime}
AND fs.user_status = #{reqVO.userStatus}
ORDER BY
mua.order_num
ASC
DESC
COALESCE(mua.consume_amount, 0)
ASC
DESC
fs.create_time DESC
ORDER BY fs.create_time DESC
